name: program_blitter_after_table_step
description: Counts down a timer and, when it expires, reloads step values from a table and advances the table pointer. It then waits for the blitter busy bit to clear, programs the blitter control, mask and size registers, and sets the source and destination pointers from the stepped offset.

name: cycle_four_entry_index_table
description: Counts down a timer and, when it expires, advances a two-bit index that wraps after four entries. It reloads the timer and the table values for the new index.

name: step_tables_and_program_blits
description: Advances two countdown-driven value tables and calls the routine stored in the step pointer. It then waits for the blitter to be idle and programs two blit operations from the accumulated offsets.

name: step_tables_and_program_blits
description: Advances two countdown-driven value tables and calls the routine stored in the step pointer. It then waits for the blitter to be idle and programs two blit operations from the accumulated offsets.

name: apply_offset_and_program_blit
description: Ors a flag mask into a word reached through a pointer register and adds a stored offset to a second word. It then waits for the blitter to be idle and programs its control, mask and size registers from the stepped values.

name: or_flags_and_program_blit
description: Ors a flag mask into a word reached through a pointer register and adds a delta to a second word. It then waits for the blitter, programs its registers from the stepped values and starts the operation.

name: advance_index_return_scaled_offset
description: Counts down a timer and, when it expires, advances a two-bit index and reloads a table value and the timer. It returns the index scaled to a table-entry offset.

name: advance_table_index_and_reload
description: Counts down a timer and, when it expires, advances a two-bit index and reloads a table value and the timer. It returns nothing.

name: step_channel_tables_and_blit
description: Counts down two timers, advancing the table pointers and offset accumulators when they expire, and calls the routine held in the step pointer. It then waits for the blitter to be idle and programs two blit operations from the accumulated values.

name: advance_channel_tables_and_blit
description: Advances the channel table steppers and accumulated offsets when their countdowns expire, calls the stored routine, then waits for the blitter and programs two blit operations.

name: set_flag_bits_and_blit
description: Sets a flag pattern in a word reached through a pointer register, waits until the blitter is idle, and programs blit registers from the accumulated offset values.

name: advance_channel_index_return_offset
description: Counts down a timer and, when it expires, advances a two-bit index and reloads a table value and the timer. It returns the index scaled to a table-entry offset.

name: advance_channel_index_and_reload
description: Counts down a timer and, when it expires, advances a two-bit index and reloads a table value and the timer. It returns nothing.

name: sample_cia_input_nibble
description: Writes select values to a CIA port register and reads a four-bit input up to four times. If the last reading is idle it returns a fixed state; otherwise it decodes the reading through a lookup table.

name: set_cia_port_select_bits
description: Writes control values to a CIA port register, setting or clearing one select bit from the low bit of its input and writing the next input bit pair into two output bits. It returns the inverted low six bits of the written value.

name: acknowledge_audio_channel_interrupts
description: Checks the interrupt request flags for two audio channels. When a flag is set it reloads an audio location register from the beam position, then writes the flags back to clear them.

name: disable_interrupts_and_loop_forever
description: Writes the interrupt-enable and DMA-control registers to disable all interrupts and the four audio DMA channels, re-enabling the master interrupt and one audio interrupt when a shared flag is set. It points the copper list register at a fixed location and then loops forever calling routines.

name: wait_for_flag_then_spin
description: Polls a shared byte until it holds the letter B and then enters an endless loop with no exit. The gap decodes as code, so this is probably not a live routine.

name: wait_for_flag_then_spin
description: Polls a shared byte until it holds the letter B and then enters an endless loop with no exit. The gap decodes as code, so this is probably not a live routine.

name: step_counter_with_raster_waits
description: Sets a shared byte to fifteen and a shared word to 255, then steps a counter up to seventeen. On each pass it calls a raster-wait routine and one further routine, so it waits through a sequence of display lines.

name: pace_display_lines_with_countdown
description: Repeats two routine calls per pass while decrementing a shared word until it drops below zero, then resets that word to zero. The calls include a raster-line wait, so it paces a sequence of display lines.

name: scale_color_entries_by_factor
description: Multiplies each of thirty-two 12-bit color values by a shared factor, scaling the red, green and blue nibbles separately. It stores the scaled values into a destination table at a stride of two words.

name: pulse_disk_control_port_line
description: Waits on a pending condition, then pulses one line of the drive control port register low and back high with waits in between. It finishes by storing a fixed value in a shared location.

name: decode_disk_sector_mfm_data
description: Starts a disk read using the MFM sync word and waits for the sync pattern and sector data. It checks an XOR checksum over the raw sector, then splits the odd and even bit streams into destination words for up to ten sectors, retrying if the sync word does not arrive.

name: seek_disk_head_to_track
description: Sets or clears the direction bit in a drive control byte from the low bit of the requested value. It then steps a shared track counter in that direction until it equals the requested track number.

name: wait_for_disk_ready_handshake
description: Waits while a status bit is set, clears a shared word and sets a control bit. It then waits for a status byte to read as the letter B followed by the letter A.

name: step_head_one_track_back
description: Sets the direction bit of the drive control byte, pulses the step bit low and back high, and decrements a shared track counter. It then waits for the status byte to read B followed by A.

name: step_head_one_track_forward
description: Clears the direction bit of the drive control byte, pulses the step bit low and back high, and increments a shared track counter. It then waits for the status byte to read B followed by A.

name: pulse_drive_control_pattern
description: Writes a fixed control pattern to the drive control port, calls a routine, then writes a second pattern. It brackets the routine with two drive control states.

name: wait_for_beam_position_change
description: Loops comparing a shared byte with its own increment, a test the decompiled form can never satisfy. The beam position register it touches suggests the routine waits for the display beam to move.

name: check_iff_form_then_process
description: Compares the four-byte value at its pointer with the chunk identifier FORM. When it matches, it calls two routines to process the chunk; otherwise it returns without doing anything.

name: load_cmap_palette_entries
description: Walks the file chunks until it finds the colour map chunk, then converts each three-byte red, green and blue triplet into a 12-bit colour value. Each value keeps the top four bits of each component and is written into a shared table.

name: unpack_iff_body_chunk
description: Finds the body chunk of an image and copies its data to the destination. When a flag byte is set it decodes run-length data, repeating runs with negative counts and copying literal runs with positive counts; otherwise it copies the raw bytes.

name: unpack_imploder_compressed_data
description: Copies a fixed block of setup data into a low scratch area, then checks for the IMP! marker. If the marker is present it decompresses the packed stream backwards from the end of the data into memory.

name: unpack_imploder_in_place
description: Decompresses an IMP! packed block in place when its marker matches, reading backwards from the end of the packed data. Its decoding loop follows the same scheme as the routine that copies the block to low memory.

name: reload_audio_pointer_on_interrupt
description: When the first audio channel's interrupt flag is set, it reloads that channel's location register from the beam position and sets a shared value. It then writes the interrupt flags back to clear them.

name: initialize_four_channel_player_state
description: Clears a block of player state, then sets initial values for four channel control entries. It computes each channel's starting table offset from a source table and marks the shared flags for a fresh start.

name: run_four_channel_playback_tick
description: Runs once per tick when a sequencing flag is clear. It advances a three-step counter and, when a pattern counter runs out, resets the channel state and updates the shared accumulator, then steps the four channel controls and writes the location and length registers for channels whose counters expire.

name: reset_four_channel_player_state
description: Clears the shared channel block and sets initial control values for four channels, as the other initializer does. It then builds a table of start offsets and marks the player as idle.

name: advance_four_channel_playback_tick
description: Runs once per tick when a sequencing flag is clear. It advances a three-step counter and, when a pattern counter runs out, resets the channel state and updates the shared accumulator, then steps the four channel controls and writes the location and length registers for channels whose counters expire.

name: update_channel_sample_pointers
description: Steps the sample playback position for each of four voices and reverses or wraps it at the end of the sample according to a loop mode. It toggles a per-voice flag and then clears the flags of the four voices.

name: load_voice_step_parameters
description: Looks up the pitch period for the current pattern step from a table and copies the volume and an effect value into the voice state. It also clears the voice's pending effect flag.

name: apply_voice_slide_and_volume
description: Copies a stored counter into the voice when a pending flag is set, then adds the slide amount to the voice period. It updates the voice volume byte from the slide value afterwards.

name: parse_voice_pattern_commands
description: Reads the next command bytes from a voice's pattern data and stores them as note or effect values. Bytes with the high bit set are stored as a wait count.

name: trigger_voice_instrument_note
description: When a note is triggered it clears the voice effect state, loads the instrument sample start, length and loop values from a table, and sets the initial volume and period. It also computes the playback speed for the note.

name: clamp_and_write_voice_period
description: Applies the current pitch slide to the voice period and clamps the result between a low and a high limit. It then writes the period to the voice audio period register after running seven update routines.

name: step_voice_slide_counter
description: Steps a voice repeat counter toward a target value. When the target is reached it adds an increment to the voice slide amount.

name: dispatch_voice_effect_by_nibble
description: Runs the pattern effect for a voice once its tick counter reaches a threshold, selecting the effect from the low nibble of the current command. The effects cover slides up and down, table-driven pitch steps, a volume setting and further pattern commands.

name: slide_period_toward_target
description: Computes a target pitch period for the voice and moves the current period toward it by the slide speed, stopping on arrival. It returns the new period value, or zero when the voice is already at its target.

name: set_voice_period_from_table
description: Looks up the pitch period for the voice current note in a table, using its offset and the note index, and stores the result as the voice period.

name: set_slide_down_amount
description: Stores the negated slide speed as the voice downward slide value and adds it to the voice pitch step accumulator.

name: set_slide_up_amount
description: Stores the slide speed as the voice upward slide value and adds it to the voice pitch step accumulator.

name: update_voice_volume_slide
description: Adds a scaled upper nibble of the effect parameter to the voice volume when its low nibble is zero, otherwise subtracts a scaled value. The result is clamped between zero and the maximum volume and written back to the voice state.

name: advance_sample_position_by_rate
description: Stores a new playback rate when the effect parameter is nonzero, then advances the sample position by the rate. The fractional counter wraps whenever it passes a boundary.

name: reset_voice_on_effect_parameter
description: When its effect parameter is nonzero, clears the voice counter and stores the parameter as a new value. It also clears the voice enable bit in a control byte.

name: set_voice_offset_from_parameter
description: When the effect parameter is below a fixed limit, it stores the sum of a shared value and the parameter into the voice state byte.

name: step_voice_pitch_offset_table
description: Advances an index through a per-voice table once a tick counter reaches its count, adding each table value to the voice period. It resets the index when it reaches the end of the table.

name: step_second_pitch_offset_table
description: Advances a second per-voice table index in the same way as the other pitch table. It sets the voice period from the table entry plus the base period.

name: advance_sample_sequence_index
description: Advances a per-voice index through a sample sequence. When a count runs out it loads the next sample start address and length from a table into the voice registers, and a negative table entry ends the sequence without loading.

name: scale_voice_volume_by_envelope
description: Copies the voice volume counter into its output field and writes a volume value to the voice register. That value is the upper half of the product of the counter and a second voice value.

name: run_voice_volume_envelope
description: Runs a volume envelope state machine for a voice, stepping the volume through its phases with phase timing taken from the instrument data. It returns early while the current phase is still running.

name: clear_shared_byte_if_zero
description: Stores zero back into a shared byte only when it is already zero, so the shared value is never changed. The routine has no effect beyond that conditional store.
